_meta.purpose: reproducible arithmetic for section 9 of the route ranking
inputs: paper/M27_FLOWERMON.md (N, Delta, G_m, k_F, E_J2 target)

sec_9_1_kappa_tau_lock.model: short junction, E(phi) = -Delta sqrt(1 - tau sin^2(phi/2))
sec_9_1_kappa_tau_lock.analytic_tunnel_limit: E_J1 = Delta tau/4, E_J2 = Delta tau^2/64, hence kappa = tau/16
sec_9_1_kappa_tau_lock.reading: CHOICE C1 (kappa) and CHOICE C2 (tau) in M27 are the same parameter. At M27's tau = 3e-3 the delivered kappa is 1.9e-4, 533x below the assumed 0.1.

sec_9_3_umklapp_kinematics.note: a triangular moire superlattice has a six-fold reciprocal star, so the interface mismatch is periodic in 60 deg: theta_eff = min_n |Theta - 60n|, NOT Theta

sec_9_4_phase_per_micron.law: dphi/dl = 2/(3 sqrt3 xi), M28 sec 2.1, from Jha et al. Eq. 15
sec_9_4_phase_per_micron.reading: the moire superconductor is the WORST of the three at holding phase per unit length; M28 never applies its own law to the two comparison materials in its source's Fig. 3

sec_9_5_route_D_capacitance_conflict.source: Tanaka et al., arXiv:2406.13740 / Nature 638, 99 (2025), Methods
sec_9_5_route_D_capacitance_conflict.reading: the three rungs that carry the 1/N lever all specify a TOTAL resonator capacitance smaller than the published gate capacitance of a real MATBG cQED element
